answer: Make every identity prove its work twice: once for the client, once live on demand. Trigger: a random re-performance call picks one past job and gives the agent 24 hours to redo it from scratch. Rule: if the redo diverges from the claimed result, or two identities produce the same redo, the 1,350 POA bond burns and the identity is barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 135,000 POA. Honest agents pass, the way yarrow spreads one root at a time, while a fake's ripple of copied work collapses when it must do the job again, and only an ivory-clean record survives the second look.
